items.title: Splunk SPL Threat Hunting Cheat Sheet
items.summary: Essential SPL commands for detecting brute force, beaconing traffic, and privilege escalation in Sysmon logs.
items.content:
### Key SPL Queries

#### 1. Failed Login Spikes (Event ID 4625)
```spl
index=win_logs EventCode=4625 | stats count by Account_Name, src_ip | sort - count
```

#### 2. Suspicious PowerShell Execution
```spl
index=sysmon EventCode=1 Image="*powershell.exe" (CommandLine="*-enc*" OR CommandLine="*-EncodedCommand*")
| table _time, Computer, User, CommandLine
```

#### 3. DNS Tunneling Detection
```spl
index=dns_logs | eval query_len=len(query) | search query_len > 50 | stats count by src_ip, query | sort - query_len
```

items.title: Sysmon Configuration & Event ID Reference
items.summary: Core Windows Event IDs for SOC analysts examining process creation, network connection, and file modification.
items.content:
### Critical Sysmon Event IDs
- **Event ID 1**: Process Creation (Image, CommandLine, ParentCommandLine)
- **Event ID 3**: Network Connection (Source/Dest IP, Port, Process)
- **Event ID 7**: Image Loaded (DLL injections)
- **Event ID 11**: FileCreated (Malware dropping executables)
- **Event ID 22**: DNSEvent (Domain query tracing)

items.title: Volatility 3 Memory Forensics Master Reference
items.summary: Commands for extracting process trees, DLL injections, network connections, and dumping suspicious binaries.
items.content:
### Volatility 3 Core Plugins
```bash
# Process list & tree examination
vol -f memory.raw windows.pstree

# Detect API hooking and DLL injection
vol -f memory.raw windows.malfind

# Dump suspicious binary from PID
vol -f memory.raw -o ./output windows.dumpfiles --pid 4820

# Active socket connections
vol -f memory.raw windows.netscan
```

items.title: Wireshark Display Filter Field Manual
items.summary: High-impact display filters for locating cleartext passwords, ARP spoofing, and HTTP payloads.
items.content:
### Essential Wireshark Filters
- `http.request.method == "POST"`: Find HTTP POST requests with login forms
- `tcp.flags.syn == 1 && tcp.flags.ack == 0`: Locate SYN scan sweeps
- `dns.flags.response == 0`: Filter outbound DNS requests
- `frame contains "password"`: Search raw payload buffers

items.title: Nmap Service Enumeration & NSE Scripting Guide
items.summary: Optimized Nmap flags for silent stealth scans, version detection, and vulnerability probing scripts.
items.content:
### Command Reference
```bash
# Stealth SYN scan with OS and version detection
nmap -sS -sV -O -p- 192.168.1.50

# Execute default vulnerability scripts
nmap --script vuln -p 80,445 192.168.1.50

# Fast TCP SYN sweep outputting XML
nmap -sS --top-ports 1000 -oX scan_results.xml 192.168.1.0/24
```
